value.behaviour: Fall back to getEntityByFormerRef when getEntityByRef misses in useEntityFromUrl and redirect to the current entity route preserving sub-routes.
rules: 1. Import `DEFAULT_NAMESPACE` and `stringifyEntityRef` from `@backstage/catalog-model`, and `useLocation` and `useParams` from `'react-router-dom'`.
2. In `useAsyncRetry`, first call `const existing = await catalogApi.getEntityByRef({ kind, namespace, name });` and return `existing` if defined.
3. When `existing` is `undefined` and `name` is non-empty, call `const formerTarget = await catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef?.({ kind, namespace, name });`.

4. If `formerTarget` is defined, compute `targetKind = formerTarget.kind.toLocaleLowerCase('en-US')`, `targetNamespace = (formerTarget.metadata.namespace ?? DEFAULT_NAMESPACE).toLocaleLowerCase('en-US')`, `targetName = formerTarget.metadata.name`, and extract `const subPath = params['*'] ?? '';`. Compute `const currentSuffix = \`/${namespace}/${kind}/${name}${subPath ? \`/${subPath}\` : ''}\`;`, `const mountPrefix = location.pathname.endsWith(currentSuffix) ? location.pathname.slice(0, location.pathname.length - currentSuffix.length) : '/catalog';`, and `const targetPath = \`${mountPrefix}/${targetNamespace}/${targetKind}/${targetName}${subPath ? \`/${subPath}\` : ''}${location.search}${location.hash}\`;`.

5. Call `navigate(targetPath, { replace: true, state: { ...(typeof location.state === 'object' && location.state !== null ? location.state : {}), renamedFrom: stringifyEntityRef({ kind, namespace, name }) } });` and return `formerTarget`.

value.behaviour: Resolve former entity names in useExternalRedirect when getEntityByRef misses, redirecting to the target entity's TechDocs URL with sub-path preserved and exposing rename state.
rules: 1. Import `DEFAULT_NAMESPACE` from `@backstage/catalog-model` and `useParams` from `'react-router-dom'`.
2. Read `const params = useParams(); const subPath = params['*'] ?? '';` and maintain a `const renameInfoRef = useRef<{ from: string; to: string; targetEntityRef: CompoundEntityRef } | null>(null);`.
3. In `useAsync`, when `await catalogApi.getEntityByRef(entityRef)` returns `undefined`, call `const formerEntity = await catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef?.(entityRef);`.

4. If `formerEntity` is returned, compute `const targetEntityRef: CompoundEntityRef = { kind: formerEntity.kind.toLocaleLowerCase('en-US'), namespace: (formerEntity.metadata.namespace ?? DEFAULT_NAMESPACE).toLocaleLowerCase('en-US'), name: formerEntity.metadata.name };`, compute the base TechDocs URL via `formerEntity.metadata?.annotations?.[TECHDOCS_EXTERNAL_ANNOTATION] ? buildTechDocsURL(formerEntity, viewTechdocLink) : viewTechdocLink(targetEntityRef)`, append `subPath ? \`/${subPath.replace(/^\/+/, '')}\` : ''` to form `redirectUrl`, store `renameInfoRef.current = { from: entityKey, to: stringifyEntityRef(targetEntityRef), targetEntityRef }`, and return `{ redirectUrl, isFormerRedirect: true, renamedFrom: entityKey, targetEntityRef }`.

5. In `useEffect`, when `!externalRedirectResult.loading && externalRedirectResult.value?.redirectUrl`, call `navigate(externalRedirectResult.value.redirectUrl, { replace: true });` and mark `checkedEntityRef.current = entityKey` when `isFormerRedirect` is true (or when there is no redirect).

6. Return `{ loading: externalRedirectResult.loading, shouldShowProgress: (shouldCheckForRedirect && externalRedirectResult.loading) || (!!externalRedirectResult.value?.redirectUrl && !externalRedirectResult.value.isFormerRedirect), renamedFrom: externalRedirectResult.value?.renamedFrom ?? (renameInfoRef.current?.to === entityKey || renameInfoRef.current?.from === entityKey ? renameInfoRef.current.from : undefined), resolvedEntityRef: externalRedirectResult.value?.targetEntityRef ?? (renameInfoRef.current?.from === entityKey ? renameInfoRef.current.targetEntityRef : undefined) }`.
